newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick did assays on Busang cores.
newsitem.headline: Barrick did assays on Busang cores.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp, the thwarted suitor of Bre-X Minerals Ltd, did tests on hundreds of Busang gold samples supplied to it by Bre-X, the company said on Monday.
But Barrick never did its own drilling.

"We started our due diligence process and that included taking the samples provided to us and doing assays. But we never did our own drilling," Barrick spokesman Vince Borg said in a telephone interview.
Borg would not discuss what the assays disclosed because of a confidentiality agreement between Barrick and Bre-X. One industry source said that the Barrick results "largely" confirmed Bre-X's.
Bre-X shares have skyrocketed over the past two years after it discovered what was touted as the largest gold find this century.

But the bubble burst last week when Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc, the new partner of Calgary-based Bre-X, said samples it had drilled and tested from the Indonesian property contained "insignificant" amounts of gold.
On Thursday, sellers hacked almost C$3 billion off Bre-X's market value when the stock resumed trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange after being halted for most of the session.
Bre-X shares were halted on the Toronto and Nasdaq exchanges on Monday, pending news.
